_: The mechanical part of the world port, as data (CATA_BACKPORT.md 4.2): table by table, which CPP rows (TrinityCore 4.3.4 TDB, database {CPP}) become which AzerothCore rows ({AC}). Columns present in both are copied by name; `set` gives a column's expression (backticked CPP columns); a column only in CPP is dropped and counted; one only in AzerothCore keeps its default. Variables: {map} the CPP map id, {new_map} its id here, {E} the entry offset (6000000), {G} this map's spawn offset, {P} the path offset (600000000). `ids` names a scratch table the first steps fill. Ranges are the zones' (mod-worgen-goblin tools/zones/build_world.py: ENTRY, GUID, PATH). Not here, and reported as `not_built` with counts: smart_scripts, conditions, creature/gameobject loot referenced by SmartAI, spells and items (zones/spells.py, items.py), phases, vehicles, areatriggers, display tables.

scratch.name: cb_creature_guid
scratch.sql: SELECT `guid`, {G} + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `guid`) AS `new_guid` FROM {CPP}.`creature` WHERE `map` = {map}

scratch.name: cb_go_guid
scratch.sql: SELECT `guid`, {G} + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `guid`) AS `new_guid` FROM {CPP}.`gameobject` WHERE `map` = {map}

scratch.name: cb_quest
scratch.sql: SELECT `quest` AS `id` FROM {CPP}.`creature_queststarter` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_creature_id) UNION SELECT `quest` FROM {CPP}.`creature_questender` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_creature_id) UNION SELECT `quest` FROM {CPP}.`gameobject_queststarter` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_go_id) UNION SELECT `quest` FROM {CPP}.`gameobject_questender` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_go_id)

scratch.name: cb_menu
scratch.sql: SELECT DISTINCT `gossip_menu_id` AS `id` FROM {CPP}.`creature_template` WHERE `entry` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_creature_id) AND `gossip_menu_id` <> 0

steps.custom: INSERT IGNORE INTO {AC}.`creature_template_model` (`CreatureID`, `Idx`, `CreatureDisplayID`, `DisplayScale`, `Probability`, `VerifiedBuild`) SELECT `entry` + {E}, 0, IF(`modelid1` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_stock_display), `modelid1`, 11686), IF(`scale` = 0, 1, `scale`), 1, 0 FROM {CPP}.`creature_template` WHERE `entry` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_creature_id) AND `modelid1` <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT `entry` + {E}, 1, IF(`modelid2` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_stock_display), `modelid2`, 11686), IF(`scale` = 0, 1, `scale`), 1, 0 FROM {CPP}.`creature_template` WHERE `entry` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_creature_id) AND `modelid2` <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT `entry` + {E}, 2, IF(`modelid3` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_stock_display), `modelid3`, 11686), IF(`scale` = 0, 1, `scale`), 1, 0 FROM {CPP}.`creature_template` WHERE `entry` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_creature_id) AND `modelid3` <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT `entry` + {E}, 3, IF(`modelid4` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_stock_display), `modelid4`, 11686), IF(`scale` = 0, 1, `scale`), 1, 0 FROM {CPP}.`creature_template` WHERE `entry` IN (SELECT `id` FROM {TMP}.cb_creature_id) AND `modelid4` <> 0;

set.AllowableRaces: (SELECT IF(a.`AllowableRaces` = 0, 0, IF((a.`AllowableRaces` & 1791) = 0, 1073741824, a.`AllowableRaces` & 1791)) FROM {CPP}.`quest_template_addon` a WHERE a.`ID` = {CPP}.`quest_template`.`ID`)
set.TimeAllowed: IFNULL((SELECT a.`TimeAllowed` FROM {CPP}.`quest_template_addon` a WHERE a.`ID` = {CPP}.`quest_template`.`ID`), 0)

steps.where: `id` IN (SELECT `waypointPathId` FROM {CPP}.`creature_addon` WHERE `guid` IN (SELECT `guid` FROM {TMP}.cb_creature_guid) AND `waypointPathId` <> 0)

stock_display: the ids of the stock CreatureDisplayInfo (data/stock_ids.json display_ids), loaded as {TMP}.cb_stock_display
